_doc: Standalone growth_bundle product type (#377): create a growth_bundle project and run it. The single growth_bundle stage calls the live worker_management 'growth-bundle' worker (already seeded — it runs inside the promo/website_review blueprints) and emits outbound channel-copy snippets; there is no video pipeline. Asserts the run reaches `completed` and the growth_bundle stage produced non-empty snippet text. NOTE: `brief.generate_video` is deliberately UNSET so the stage's require_video gate passes (setting it false would skip the only stage); the deliverable `format` is a nominal '1x1' placeholder never consumed on this text-only path.

brief.value_proposition: Cut churn 20% in 30 days with these three moves.
